jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Simple** ================ Simple AI is building state of the art voice AI agents for enterprise. Our realistic agents help iconic businesses like Doordash, xAI, and Omaha Steaks handle all kinds of phone operations, from customer support to order intake to lead qualifications. We are growing revenue like crazy and looking to hire a couple founding software engineers to help us stay afloat of current customer demand and also build out systems for the future. We are very excited about the potential for AI to change the world, and work out of our SF based office. Simple AI raised $14M from world\-class investors and operators like Y Combinator, First Harmonic, Massive Tech Ventures, Michael Seibel, Jared Friedman, Alexandr Wang, Matt Van Horn, Suhail Doshi, and Scott Wu. **The Team** ============ The founders (Catheryn and Zach) met while running software teams at YC, where they shipped tons of new products for YC founders, including YC’s co\-founder matching site. Cat previously worked at Instagram and Facebook and earned degrees in math and computer science at MIT. Zach previously studied computer science and statistics at U Chicago and led software at PEAK6\. We have grown into a strong team of 20\+ and are continuing to scale quickly. **About the Role** ================== Simple AI builds AI voice agents that handle real customer conversations over the phone. Our agents help businesses generate revenue and improve customer retention. We’re hiring a Platform Engineer to build and run the infrastructure behind those conversations. Real\-time voice has demanding reliability requirements: latency is immediately noticeable, calls are stateful, and deployments need to happen without interrupting customers. You’ll work directly with the founders and engineering team to make our platform reliable, scalable, and easy to build on. This is a hands\-on engineering role with meaningful ownership over infrastructure architecture and how we ship software. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive salary \& meaningful equity * Employee\-friendly equity terms * An office located in SF * Health, dental \& vision insurance * Free lunch \& dinner at the office * Late night Ubers * Regular team events \& offsites **What you’ll do** ================== * Build and operate AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Kubernetes, including EKS clusters, networking, IAM, load balancing, and secrets management. * Develop reusable infrastructure modules and consistent development, staging, and production environments. * Build deployment workflows with automated checks, clear deployment visibility, and reliable rollbacks. * Design autoscaling and graceful shutdown behavior for services handling long\-running voice conversations. * Improve observability across infrastructure and application services, with useful dashboards, actionable alerts, and clear reliability and latency metrics. * Investigate production issues, improve incident response, and address recurring problems at their source. * Partner with application and AI engineers to deploy new services, improve performance, and manage infrastructure costs. * Make it easier for engineers to provision resources, deploy changes, and debug their services safely. **What we’re looking for** ========================== * Hands\-on experience running Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. * Strong Terraform experience, including maintainable modules, state management, and safe infrastructure changes. * A solid understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and distributed systems. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and operating services through deployments, incidents, and growth. * Ability to write software and automation in a language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript. * Good judgment about when to introduce new infrastructure and when to keep things simple. * Someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and follows problems through to a lasting fix. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience with Argo CD, Helm, or other GitOps tooling. * Familiarity with real\-time audio, SIP, WebRTC, or other latency\-sensitive systems. * Experience operating PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, and background workers. * Experience deploying GPU workloads or self\-hosted AI inference. * Familiarity with infrastructure security and supporting SOC 2 requirements. **Why Simple AI** ================= You’ll shape the infrastructure of a growing voice AI company and see your work directly affect real customer conversations. There’s room to make architectural decisions, build useful tools, and establish engineering practices that the team will rely on as we grow. Compensation Range: $140 \- $250,000

jobs.description: ML Engineer \- Model Evaluation Specialist (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Inference
jobs.description: Mount Thor is hiring a founding inference engineer to build a production inference platform on Apple Silicon. You will own the stack from GPU kernels and model execution to distributed scheduling, networking, and customer\-facing serving systems. **Who We Are** -------------- Mount Thor makes Apple hardware—macOS and Apple Silicon—available at datacenter scale for AI workloads. We build the infrastructure around that hardware to deliver elastic compute through developer\-friendly interfaces. We are building an inference platform that gives developers a straightforward way to deploy and serve models on Apple Silicon, backed by deep engineering across hardware, runtimes, and distributed systems. **The Role** ------------ You will establish the technical foundation for inference at Mount Thor. You will define the architecture, write the performance\-critical code, and take the system through deployment and production operation. Your scope spans the complete path from an incoming inference request to execution on the hardware and a response back to the customer. You will work across kernels, compilers, inference engines, memory management, model parallelism, networking, scheduling, and serving APIs. You will make decisions about where to extend existing open\-source systems and where to build new components. You will work closely with Platform, Fleet, and Network Infrastructure engineering to turn individual machines into a reliable inference service. You will own the tradeoffs among latency, throughput, model quality, reliability, and cost, and use measurements to guide the work. **In this role you will** ------------------------- * **Build and optimize the inference engine.** Implement model execution, continuous batching, prefill and decode scheduling, KV\-cache management, prefix caching, and memory allocation. Bring new model architectures into production and implement optimizations such as quantization, speculative decoding, and chunked prefill. * **Write performance\-critical kernels and runtime code.** Implement and optimize operations such as matrix multiplication, attention, and mixture\-of\-experts execution. Work across Metal, MLX, and compiler and runtime internals to improve memory access, operator fusion, synchronization, and CPU/GPU execution. Validate numerical correctness alongside performance. * **Design for Apple Silicon.** Build around unified memory, memory bandwidth, compute capabilities, and operating\-system behavior. Profile execution on real hardware, diagnose bottlenecks, and choose model representations and execution strategies based on measured results. * **Build distributed inference and its communication layer.** Implement model sharding and parallel execution across machines. Develop and optimize collective communication, data movement, and the overlap between computation and communication. Work with network engineers on transport performance, topology, and failure handling. * **Own inference scheduling and routing.** Build request queues, admission control, cache\-aware routing, model placement, and autoscaling. Manage capacity and tenant fairness while meeting latency and throughput targets across changing traffic patterns and model sizes. * **Ship a production inference service.** Build model loading and deployment workflows, serving APIs, streaming responses, cancellation, and backpressure. Integrate the runtime with fleet and platform systems. Own observability, safe releases, incident diagnosis, and recovery for the inference stack. * **Make performance reproducible.** Build benchmarks and profiling tools that measure time to first token, inter\-token latency, tail latency, throughput, memory use, power, and cost per token. Test realistic workloads, concurrency, and context lengths. Catch performance and model\-quality regressions before release. * **Set the engineering direction.** Turn customer workloads into technical priorities, choose and contribute to open\-source projects, and establish clear interfaces across the stack. Use coding agents to investigate, implement, and validate changes, backed by correctness checks and reproducible benchmarks. **What you bring** ------------------ * A record of building and optimizing production inference engines, GPU compute software, or distributed ML systems, with substantial depth in at least one and hands\-on work across multiple layers. * Strong systems programming skills in C\+\+ or Rust, proficiency in Python, and experience working inside performance\-critical libraries and runtimes. * A practical understanding of transformer inference, including attention, prefill and decode, batching, KV caches, quantization, and their compute and memory costs. * Experience with GPU programming and performance analysis, including memory hierarchies, parallel execution, synchronization, and numerical precision. * Strong distributed\-systems fundamentals, including scheduling, concurrency, networking, failure handling, and resource management. * Experience taking software from architecture through production deployment, debugging, and ongoing operation. * The ability to turn an ambiguous performance problem into a measured bottleneck, an implementation, and a verified improvement. * The judgment and ownership to establish a new technical area, prioritize the work, and explain tradeoffs clearly to engineers and customers. **Bonus Skills** ---------------- * Built with or contributed to MLX, MLX\-LM, llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM, or similar systems. * Written Metal kernels or worked on Apple GPU performance, macOS internals, unified\-memory management, or compiler infrastructure. * Implemented tensor, pipeline, or expert parallelism; distributed KV caches; or disaggregated prefill and decode. * Built collective communication libraries or optimized inference over Ethernet, Thunderbolt, or RDMA transports. * Shipped a multi\-tenant inference service, model\-serving control plane, or serverless compute product. * Helped establish an engineering team or core infrastructure product at an early\-stage company.

jobs.title: Part-Time Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Product Architect
jobs.description: **Job** **Pulxe · Nexaris Innovations Inc.** **Remote · Part\-Time Founding Executive · Cash and Equity Compensation** **About Pulxe** Pulxe is an angel\-backed, early\-stage technology startup creating a safety\-first digital platform for children, parents, and emerging creators. Our vision is to give young people a secure and inspiring environment where they can learn, create, communicate, and share—while giving parents meaningful visibility, safeguards, and control. Pulxe will bring together social interaction, video, rewarded learning, journaling, live streaming, AI\-assisted film and music creation, and digital payments within one thoughtfully designed platform. Child safety is not an additional feature. It is a foundational part of the product’s identity, architecture, and operating philosophy. Pulxe is currently in its pre\-launch product\-development stage. The company has a live design prototype, a documented technical blueprint, an intellectual\-property portfolio, initial angel investment, and additional seed funding and federal research\-grant initiatives underway. We are now looking for an experienced technology leader who is excited to join a small, focused team of innovators and help transform a bold product vision into a secure, scalable, and engaging digital experience for families. **The Opportunity** The Part\-Time Chief Technology Officer will serve as Pulxe’s senior technology leader and product architect. This opportunity is designed for an accomplished CTO, technology executive, principal engineer, or product architect who would like to contribute their expertise to a promising startup while maintaining another professional role or portfolio of responsibilities. You will work closely with the CEO, Chief Strategy Officer, product designers, advisors, and future engineering team to guide Pulxe from technical planning through MVP development and launch. Although this is initially a part\-time position, it is a meaningful executive role—not simply an advisory appointment. You will have genuine influence over the product, architecture, engineering culture, technical roadmap, and future technology organization. The ideal candidate enjoys working with small, highly committed teams, can balance strategic leadership with selective hands\-on contribution, and wants to help create technology that positively serves children and parents. **What You Will Lead** **Product and Technology Strategy** * Own and evolve Pulxe’s overall technology strategy, platform architecture, and technical roadmap. * Review the existing technical blueprint and recommend where the architecture should be retained, simplified, or phased to support an efficient MVP launch. * Translate the company’s product vision into practical engineering priorities, milestones, budgets, and development plans. * Guide decisions involving build\-versus\-buy, monolithic\-versus\-microservices sequencing, cloud infrastructure, data architecture, mobile applications, third\-party integrations, and AI services. * Establish a technology foundation that can grow responsibly as the product, user base, and engineering team expand. **Product Development and Delivery** * Provide hands\-on technical leadership during MVP development, including architecture reviews, code reviews, prototyping, and resolution of significant engineering challenges. * Help select, manage, and support the founding development team, contractors, and specialist technology partners. * Establish development standards, documentation practices, testing requirements, CI/CD processes, and release\-management procedures. * Maintain clear visibility into development progress, technical dependencies, product risks, and launch readiness. * Ensure that the team remains focused on shipping a secure and useful initial product without unnecessary complexity. **Child Safety, Privacy, and Trust** * Lead the technical design of Pulxe’s guardian\-and\-child account structure, parental controls, age\-appropriate experiences, and content\-safety systems. * Design pre\-publication moderation and escalation processes for content involving children. * Embed privacy, security, and responsible data practices throughout the product\-development lifecycle. * Help the company prepare for relevant child\-safety and data\-protection requirements, including COPPA and applicable international privacy frameworks. * Establish a technology culture in which the safety and well\-being of children take priority over engagement or growth targets. **Time Commitment and Working Relationship** This is initially a **part\-time, remote executive position** with a flexible schedule. We anticipate an average commitment of approximately **\[10–20 hours per week]**, including a regular leadership meeting, scheduled architecture and product\-development sessions, and reasonable availability for important technical decisions. We welcome experienced professionals who currently hold another compatible position, operate an advisory practice, or manage a portfolio of technology engagements. Any outside commitments must permit the candidate to meet Pulxe’s responsibilities and avoid conflicts involving intellectual property, competition, confidentiality, or employment obligations. As the company closes additional funding and moves into full product development, the position may expand by mutual agreement. A future full\-time CTO opportunity may be available, but it is not a requirement for initial consideration. Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Employee discount * Flexible schedule * Professional development assistance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Robot Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT HAPTICA** Haptica is building the standard for tactile in robotics. We build tactile sensing wearables for robots and people. Gloves and sensors that you can put on a gripper or robot hand. Teleop teams use Haptica to give human operators low\-latency haptic feedback that allows them to feel what the robot feels. Data ops teams use Haptica to collect UMI, egocentric, and teleop data to train their models. Haptica was founded by Dr. Cosima du Pasquier and Paola Peraza Calderon in early 2026 and is backed by top tier investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Leitmotif, NVP Capital, and Sarah Smith Fund. Haptica’s advisors include famed roboticist Rodney Brooks, Benchmark Capital co\-founder Andy Rachleff, and haptics expert Allison Okamura. We’re a small and mighty team of builders driven to unlock touch as the new frontier. The next 6 months for us are all about building high quality hardware, quantifiably establishing the impact of tactile data on learning policies, and hiring A\-players that can help us scale in 2027\. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We’re looking for a Robot Learning Engineer to own the entire function at Haptica. We do not deploy robots, but we need to have in\-house training capabilities to measure our effectiveness. This includes creating our training pipeline, stress\-testing our sensors, determining what data to collect and how, evaluating policies on the robot, and helping customers integrate our data into their stack. You’ll have extreme autonomy, but you won’t need to start from scratch. We have a robot arm in the office, basic glove\-based hand\-tracking, and have laid the groundwork to train our own policies. We just need someone to take it further. The sky is the limit for this role, but to start we have three broad goals: * Build our internal data collection pipeline alongside our hardware team * Drive and publish research to establish the role of tactile data in learning * Inform the roadmap for how our customers will use our data in their stack **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Build our data collection, training and inference pipeline on off\-the\-shelf hardware integrated with Haptica. * Train imitation learning policies (ACT, diffusion policy) with and without our tactile data on tasks where touch matters most: shear, occluded grasps, delicate objects. * Define how we evaluate. Benchmark tasks that reuse publicly researched setups, metrics, and tooling to quantify the impact of our data and the variance of the impact across tasks. * Extend data collection from teleop to egocentric glove data. Integrate hand tracking, test retargeting from a human hand to grippers and multi fingered hands, and run experiments that decide how many fingers we track. * Influence hardware decisions based on what our sensing needs to deliver for learning. You'll have opinions on sampling rate, resolution, synchronization, drift, and calibration. * Stay on the bleeding edge of how the world's best companies are running robot learning, and help us integrate Haptica into customers' data collection and teleoperation setup. * Share your findings with the world through demo videos, writeups, and papers with our academic collaborators at Stanford, MIT, and more. **WHO YOU ARE** * You have a MS or PhD in robotics, CS, EE or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. * Extensive experience in production\-level software and ML engineering best practices. * Experience with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). * You're an outstandingly strong written and verbal communicator skilled at simplifying complex topics to teammates, customers, investors, and friends. You make it look easy. * You know the fundamentals for running imitation learning (diffusion policy, ACT or similar) from data collection to training, deployment, and debugging. * You're comfortable with hardware. You've worked with cameras, IMUs, calibration, time synchronization across sensors. You have an intuition for hardware decisions that matter. * You're comfortable with ambiguity, and get excited at the thought of building from scratch, defining your own constraints, and closely partnering with both internal and external teams. **BONUS IF** * You have experience with dexterous manipulation, multi\-fingered hands, or retargeting * You're passionate about tactile and have relevant research or experience in sensing * You have experience taking egocentric or wearable data through to a trained policy * You have a strong publication record in a relevant field * Prior work on humanoids or highly dexterous robotic platforms

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist (Physical AI/Interpretability)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About World Mechanics** ========================= World Mechanics is a commercial R\&D neo\-lab developing interpretable foundation models of and for the physical world. We study what mechanisms world models learn about the systems they are trained on, and how to make those mechanisms more faithful to the underlying causal structure of those systems. We believe that models which learn interpretable, causal abstractions can provide a more principled foundation for explaining predictions, verifying model behavior, and monitoring and controlling models in deployment. Our goal is to build general\-purpose world models that serve as reliable simulators of physical systems and can be deployed broadly across applications ranging from prediction and maintenance to robotics and scientific discovery. We focus on three connected research directions: * white\-box evaluation of physical models, * training intrinsically interpretable foundation models for the physical world, * interpretability\-based learned simulators for physical systems. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Own end\-to\-end research programs aligned with our core agenda (white\-box evaluation, intrinsically interpretable model training, and interpretability\-based simulation), from problem selection to rigorous experimental validation to internal documentation and delivery. * Set technical direction across world models trained on video, sensor, time\-series, and other multimodal data, identifying which modeling and interpretability approaches generalize across physical domains. * Set clear milestones, de\-risk the hard unknowns early, and make high\-quality calls on what to pursue next based on evidence. * Drive strong research practice across the team: experimental design, iteration loops, ablations, evaluation methodology, and clear write\-ups. * Mentor and support other researchers and research engineers; provide technical guidance, feedback, and (as the team grows) direct management. * Partner with leadership and (when relevant) customers to translate real needs into repeatable technical capabilities. * Lead and supervise publications and model releases, including open\-source releases, when aligned with our commercial and customer goals. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * Track record of high\-impact ML research with strong taste and consistent execution. * Ability to generate original research directions *and* deliver concrete results under resource constraints. * Startup alignment: high agency, fast iteration, low ego, and comfortable wearing multiple hats. * Pragmatic, empirical mindset; avoids safety/capability ideology and lab politics while still taking real\-world risks seriously. * Strong writing and communication; you can make research legible to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Prior work directly tied to mechanistic interpretability, multimodal/video world models, robotics foundation models, or scientific/industrial time\-series. * Experience translating research into product capabilities, or building platforms used by other researchers. **Our values** ============== **Empirical Rigor and Intellectual Openness** We approach research with an open mind and let evidence guide our decisions. We test assumptions, update our views when the facts change, and focus our efforts where they can have the greatest impact. We value clear thinking and practical progress over allegiance to particular schools of thought or debates that are not supported by meaningful evidence. **Ownership and Initiative** We seek people who are energized by the pace, autonomy, and ambiguity of an early\-stage company. Our team members take responsibility beyond narrow job descriptions, move quickly from ideas to execution, and reliably carry work through to completion. We value genuine commitment to the mission and the desire to build, not simply to participate. **Seriousness, Kindness, and Mutual Respect** We aim to build a team of thoughtful, optimistic, and grounded people who care deeply about both the quality of their work and how they treat others. We keep ideological and political debates—including factional debates around AI safety and capabilities—outside the workplace and maintain our focus on the work itself. We welcome substantive disagreement while holding a high bar for respect, integrity, and professional conduct. **Research with Real\-World Impact** We pursue research with the intention of translating it into useful products and capabilities. We value researchers who are enthusiastic about commercialization and want to see their work succeed beyond the research environment. Staying close to product, engineering, and—when useful—customers and real\-world settings helps ensure that our research remains grounded in genuine needs and constraints. **Compensation** ================ **Senior Research Scientist (US):** * **Base salary:** **$300,000 – $500,000** * **Equity:** *Competitive; disclosed during process.* **What we offer** ----------------- * Flexible working hours * Conference travel support, with opportunities to publish and open\-source research when aligned with our commercial and customer goals * Office space and in\-person collaboration * High\-ownership role with substantial responsibility and autonomy * Problems worth working on: research that has direct commercial and real\-world safety/economic relevance **How to apply** ---------------- We run a high\-signal process designed for researchers: * Intro conversation (mission \+ mutual fit) * Take\-home \+ technical deep dive with the research team * (optional) For finalists: a short, paid trial project scoped to the role We are especially interested in candidates with unconventional backgrounds or non\-traditional paths. If you’re not sure you check every box, we still encourage you to apply. Compensation Range: $300K \- $500K

jobs.title: Application Support Specialist
jobs.description: **The Role** The Technical Applications \& Support Specialist is a hands\-on technical role supporting both our customers and our internal engineering projects. You'll operate and maintain 3D printers and scanners, execute customer printing and scanning projects, troubleshoot and repair equipment, provide technical support, install systems, and train customers. You'll also work alongside our engineering team on prototypes, applications, testing, scanning, and additive manufacturing projects. This is not a call\-center support job. You'll be physically working with machines, parts, materials, software, customers, and engineering projects every day. **About 3DChimera** 3DChimera is a Miami\-based advanced manufacturing technology company helping manufacturers solve real\-world problems using 3D printing, 3D scanning, mechanical design, CAD software, and engineering services. We sell, support, and operate professional and industrial manufacturing technologies—and we use those same technologies every day for customer projects. We're looking for a technically capable, hands\-on person with real 3D printing experience who wants to build a career working across additive manufacturing, 3D scanning, customer applications, equipment service, and technical support. **What You'll Do** * Operate professional and industrial 3D printers * Operate 3D scanners and perform customer scanning projects * Prepare, slice, launch, monitor, and complete print jobs * Perform build preparation, part removal, cleaning, post\-processing, and finishing * Maintain printers, scanners, and related equipment * Diagnose mechanical, electrical, software, and process\-related equipment problems * Perform equipment repairs, maintenance, calibration, and component replacement * Provide first\-line technical support to customers by phone, email, remote session, and in person * Install and commission equipment at customer facilities * Train customers on equipment operation, maintenance, software, and workflows * Support customer demonstrations, sample builds, evaluations, and trade shows * Assist our engineering team with prototypes, testing, scanning, printing, and project execution * Document service activities, procedures, recurring problems, and solutions * Maintain equipment, tools, materials, spare parts, and technical work areas * Escalate complex engineering or technical issues when appropriate **What We're Looking For** Prior hands\-on 3D printing experience is required. We're looking for someone who has actually operated, maintained, repaired, built, or extensively worked with 3D printing equipment. Your experience might come from: * A 3D printing or additive manufacturing company * An equipment manufacturer or reseller * A manufacturing environment * A university or technical lab * A makerspace * Field service or equipment repair * Serious hands\-on personal experience with additive manufacturing A four\-year engineering degree is **not required**. We care much more about whether you're technically capable, mechanically curious, comfortable around equipment, good with customers, and able to methodically figure out why something isn't working. You Should Be Comfortable With * Taking equipment apart—and getting it back together correctly * Diagnosing mechanical and basic electrical problems * Learning unfamiliar machines and software * Following and developing technical procedures * Working independently * Managing multiple customer and internal projects * Talking customers through technical problems * Explaining technical concepts clearly * Keeping good notes and documenting your work * Knowing when to keep troubleshooting and when to escalate * Occasionally traveling to customer facilities for installation, training, or service Experience with any of the following is a plus: * 3D scanning * Reverse engineering * FFF/FDM 3D printing * SLS 3D printing * SLA/DLP resin printing * Bambu Lab equipment * Industrial additive manufacturing systems * Shining3D scanners * SOLIDWORKS * CAD * Field service * Electromechanical troubleshooting * Customer training * Manufacturing equipment * Technical customer support You don't need to know every technology we work with on day one. You **do** need enough relevant hands\-on experience that we're building on an existing technical foundation rather than starting from zero. **What Success Looks Like** Our equipment runs reliably. Customer printing and scanning projects get completed accurately and on time. Customers receive fast, competent technical support. Problems get diagnosed and solved rather than simply passed along. Our engineers are able to focus on engineering while you take ownership of equipment operation, routine applications work, service, and first\-line support. Over time, you become someone our customers and team trust when something needs to work. **Why 3DChimera?** You'll get hands\-on experience with a much wider range of advanced manufacturing technologies than you would operating one machine or supporting one product all day. You'll work directly with engineers, customers, manufacturers, and new technologies across 3D printing, 3D scanning, design, reverse engineering, and advanced manufacturing. This is a great fit for someone who genuinely likes machines, likes helping people, and gets satisfaction from figuring out how things work. **How to Apply:** Send your cover letter and resume to alex@3dchimera.com Pay: $35,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Maintenance Planner
jobs.description: **Maintenance Planner** **Making Better Happen** Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the windy coast where Sweden and Denmark meet. From our success in Scandinavia, we've grown into the world's leading specialist producer of plant\-based oils, employing more than 4000 people all across the globe. We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it's not just food \- we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet. Every one of us works towards our shared purpose: Making Better Happen™. Everything we do is about Making Better Happen together. Join nearly 4,000 like\-minded colleagues globally and build a better future with us. Build a better future as a Maintenance Planner in Newark, NJ Compensation Range: $91,000 \- $105,000 Possible Bonus: 7\.5% **AAK Newark** **About the role** The Maintenance Planner is responsible for the planning, scheduling, and Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) administration that drives the site's maintenance program. This role plans and schedules preventive, corrective, emergency, and predictive work orders, maintains the integrity of maintenance data in the CMMS, and partners closely with the Plant Engineer, Maintenance Manager, and MRO Specialist to ensure work is planned with the right parts, labor, and information so it can be executed safely, efficiently, and on schedule. **Responsibilities** Develop, publish, and maintain the site's daily and weekly maintenance schedules in the CMMS, balancing preventive, corrective, emergency, and predictive work against available labor, parts, and asset availability. Review and triage all incoming work requests (PM, CM, EM, PdM), assigning priority, craft, and target completion timeframe in the CMMS. Plan corrective and preventive work orders in the CMMS, identifying required parts, labor hours, tools, permits, and job procedures before releasing work to the maintenance team. Build, standardize, and continuously refine the PM task library and PM schedules to maximize equipment reliability and compliance. Generate and release PM work orders on schedule and monitor PM compliance against site targets. Partner with the Reliability team to translate predictive maintenance (PdM) findings (vibration, thermography, oil analysis) into scoped, planned corrective work orders. Own and continuously groom the maintenance backlog, ensuring aging work orders are prioritized, resourced, and scheduled appropriately. Serve as the primary administrator of the CMMS for the maintenance department, including workflow configuration, asset hierarchy and equipment master data integrity, and data entry standards. Ensure accurate work order closeout, failure coding, and documentation in the CMMS for all completed preventive, corrective, emergency, and predictive work. Coordinate with the MRO Specialist to confirm parts availability and lead times ahead of scheduled work, and flag reorder point or min/max needs for critical spares. Develop and distribute maintenance KPI and metrics reporting (PM compliance, backlog aging, MTTR/MTBF, wrench time) to maintenance leadership. Partner with the Plant Engineer and Maintenance Manager to align weekly schedules with production priorities, outages, and turnaround plans. Maintain job plans, standard work instructions, and equipment documentation to support consistent, repeatable work execution. Support root cause analysis and reliability improvement initiatives by supplying historical work order, failure, and cost data. **About you** Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance Management, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent experience considered. 3\+ years of experience in an industrial or manufacturing maintenance environment, with prior maintenance planning and scheduling experience strongly preferred. Proficient with CMMS platforms for work order planning, scheduling, and reporting; eMaint x5 experience strongly preferred. Solid understanding of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance strategies and reliability\-centered maintenance principles. Working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and rotating equipment systems, including pumps, gearboxes, motors, conveyors, and valves. Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage a multi\-craft schedule and shifting priorities. Effective communicator able to work cross\-functionally with technicians, supervisors, operations, and the reliability team. Proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook) and comfortable interpreting technical drawings, manuals, and equipment documentation. Certified Maintenance \& Reliability Professional (CMRP) or similar certification a plus. **In return AAK offer** Career paths, training and development, e\-learning and tuition reimbursement programs offer potential for you to progress your future career Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental and vision) starting date of hire Health Savings Account with AAK annual contribution of $1,000\-$1,500 We match 100% of the first 3% you contribute to your 401(k), and 50% of the next 3% Free Life and Disability insurance Employee Assistance Program Supplemental Pet Insurance, Identity Theft Protection and Legal Insurance Plans Discounts on travel, amusement parks, concerts, movies, and more Celebrations, events, and activities on site and supporting our communities Recognition incentives for service and peer to peer recognition **About AAK** Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialize in plant\-based oils that are the value\-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co\-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer, with the unique flexibility of our production assets, and a deep knowledge of many products and industries, including Chocolate \& Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant\-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care. Our 4,000 employees support our close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and with the support of more than 20 production facilities. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and with our headquarters in Malmö, Sweden, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years. **AAK prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, religion, veteran status, and any other class of individuals protected from discrimination under state or federal law in any aspect of the access to, admission, or treatment of students in its programs and activities, or in employment and application for employment.**

jobs.title: Project Manager, Client Delivery
jobs.description: **Role: Project Manager, Client Delivery** **Superpower:** **Project Orchestrator** Above The Fray is seeking a Project Manager, Client Delivery to join our Client Services team. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role responsible for keeping assigned digital commerce accounts organized, financially visible, clearly communicated, and moving forward. The Project Manager serves as the operational counterpart to ATF’s technical and delivery leaders. While subject matter experts focus on strategy, solutions, and execution, this person maintains command of the project plan, budget, communication, decisions, commitments, and follow\-through. This is not a department leadership role. It is a working project management position for someone who enjoys being close to clients, teams, numbers, and day\-to\-day delivery. **Who You Are** You notice what needs to be done and act. You keep the right people informed, but you do not wait to be asked or use communication as a substitute for action. You raise concerns early and constructively, focusing on solutions rather than blame. You treat feedback as useful information, give it respectfully, and receive it without defensiveness. People trust you because you follow through. You do what you said you would do, when you said you would do it, and exceed the quality expected. When projects become pressured or unclear, you remain calm, direct, and easy to work alongside. You are comfortable working in the details while maintaining awareness of the broader client relationship, financial position, and delivery objective. **What You Will Own** ***Client Delivery and Communication*** You will be the day\-to\-day operational lead for assigned accounts. You will understand what the client is trying to accomplish, keep communication moving, and make sure conversations turn into clear decisions and action. * Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned clients. * Maintain awareness of client priorities, concerns, decisions, and commitments. * Respond promptly and ensure requests are acknowledged, assigned, and followed through. * Build trust through preparation, transparency, responsiveness, and consistency. * Participate in discovery sessions, planning meetings, business reviews, onsite engagements, and industry events as needed. * Communicate delivery risks, dependencies, budget constraints, and required tradeoffs clearly. ***Project Operations and Financial Visibility*** You will maintain an accurate view of how each project is performing and surface issues before they become emergencies. * Track project financials, working hours, burn rates, milestones, forecasts, and team capacity. * Monitor account staffing allocations and analyze how resource levels affect project budgets and delivery. * Flag budget overages, underutilization, time\-tracking errors, forecast variances, and scope risks for team review. * Work with finance, operations, and delivery leaders to investigate discrepancies and prepare clear explanations. * Support prioritization, downscoping, and change\-management discussions when requested work exceeds available budget. * Provide concise reporting on budget position, forecast, staffing impact, and emerging financial risks. ***Planning, Coordination, and Follow\-Through*** You will create the structure that allows clients and delivery teams to move efficiently. * Own project plans, milestones, dependencies, action items, and delivery calendars. * Maintain the backlog and sprint board in close partnership with technical and client leads, ensuring work is prioritized, sufficiently defined, assigned, and ready to move forward. * Coordinate with Technical Architects, squad leads, engineers, designers, QA, marketing specialists, and other contributors. * Ensure teams have the information, access, approvals, and client input required to complete their work. * Organize planning sessions, demos, backlog reviews, and other delivery meetings appropriate to the account. * Ensure each meeting results in clear decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and documented follow\-through. * Surface blockers and unresolved decisions before they affect delivery. * Maintain the project’s decisions, risks, commitments, action items, and delivery status, coordinating with technical leads on technical documentation. * Maintain ticket hygiene by ensuring all work is assigned through properly written tickets with clear scope, description, and acceptance criteria. **What Success Looks Like** * Clients receive timely, clear communication and understand what happens next. * Budgets, staffing concerns, scope risks, and delivery issues are surfaced early. * Project plans, boards, forecasts, action logs, and ownership remain current and reliable. * Meetings produce decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity. * Technical and delivery leaders can focus on their areas of expertise without repeatedly chasing administrative follow\-up. * Assigned accounts become more organized, predictable, and financially healthy. * Clients and teammates view you as dependable, constructive, and easy to work with under pressure. **Qualifications** * Approximately 3 to 5 years of project management, client delivery, account coordination, or related experience. * Experience in an agency, consultancy, software company, ecommerce business, or another client\-service environment. * Experience coordinating digital, ecommerce, website, software, or technical projects. * Demonstrated responsibility for budgets, schedules, client communication, project reporting, or resource coordination. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain awareness across several active accounts. * Comfort working with project financials, forecasts, staffing allocations, and delivery reporting. * Ability to turn conversations into clear decisions, actions, owners, and deadlines. * Strong client\-facing written and verbal communication. * Ability to identify risks, gaps, and inconsistencies without waiting for someone else to raise them. * Experience working with distributed or international teams is helpful. * Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Tempo, Slack, Google Workspace, and major ecommerce platforms is beneficial but not required. **Reporting Structure** ***Reports to:*** Client Services leadership, working closely with ATF’s technical and delivery leaders. ***Direct reports:*** None currently. The role may provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to project coordinators or other delivery support roles. **Why Above The Fray?** We are driven by our simple, straightforward aim; **Make it Better.** Ideal candidates will embrace and live this ethos in their everyday interactions and activity. * Work with the best. Every team member at ATF raises the bar for each other. A wide array of skill sets and talents, all at the top of their game. Expect to grow, and to promote the growth of others. * We own our work. Things don’t always go perfectly in custom software development, but leadership will have your back and fight for the success of both the ATF team and our clients. * We really enjoy problem\-solving together. As the climate allows, we regularly have team celebrations and company events. Happy hours, potlucks, company retreats, and international travel opportunities. * Flourishing platform partnerships with folks like Adobe, Magento, BigCommerce, Shopware, and many more staple companies in the digital commerce universe. * Unique opportunities for skill development and professional growth. * Be a part of something bigger than the sum of our parts. Being a contributing member of our community means we think beyond the confines of our business, and support the environment that props us up. **Job Type:** Full\-time **Locations:** * Remote, anywhere USA (midwest/east coast preferred) **Compensation:** * **$120k DOE** **Equal Opportunity** Above The Fray is an equal\-opportunity employer. We embrace diverse talent and lived experience and provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, disability, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Pay: $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Parental leave Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Mid\-to\-Senior Network Software Engineer to help design, build, and operate the networking platform that powers large\-scale cloud\-native infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud networking, and networking infrastructure. You will work on technologies including Kubernetes, Cilium/eBPF, Envoy Proxy, Contour, service mesh, and cloud networking across AWS and Azure. A key part of this role is building and evolving custom networking control planes that translate high\-level application and networking intent into dynamic proxy and dataplane configuration. **What You Will Do:** **Build Network Control Planes:** Design, develop, and operate custom Kubernetes\-native networking control planes, similar to architectures used by Istio and Contour, that translate declarative APIs and configuration into dynamically programmed data planes. **Program Envoy via xDS:** Build and maintain control\-plane integrations using Envoy xDS APIs, including LDS, RDS, CDS, and EDS, to dynamically configure listeners, routes, clusters, endpoints, and traffic policies. **Build Cloud\-Native Networking Platforms:** Design and operate Kubernetes networking capabilities including CNI, network policy, service routing, load balancing, DNS. **Work with Cilium:** Deploy, operate, and optimize Cilium\-based Kubernetes networking, including network policy and observability **Extend Proxy Capabilities:** Develop or integrate Envoy filters, extensions, external authorization, traffic policies, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and other L4/L7 capabilities. **Design Cloud Networking:** Work with networking services across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet networking, load balancers, NAT, routing, private connectivity. **Build Network Observability:** Develop telemetry and troubleshooting capabilities using metrics, logs, tracing, network flows, Hubble, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. **Drive Reliability at Scale:** Participate in architecture reviews, production readiness, incident response, root\-cause analysis and reliability improvements for critical networking infrastructure. **Shape Next\-Generation Networking:** Evaluate emerging technologies including Gateway API, eBPF networking, AI/agent gateways, MCP, Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocols, and agent/service mesh architectures. **Participate in On\-Call Rotation:** Participate in the team's on\-call rotation to support production networking infrastructure, solve incidents, restore service, and drive root\-cause analysis and long\-term reliability improvements. What We Are Looking For: **Software Engineering:** 4\+ years of experience developing production software, infrastructure platforms, networking systems, or distributed systems. **Programming:** Strong proficiency in Go and experience with one or more languages such as Python, Rust **Networking Control Planes:** Experience building, extending, or maintaining networking control\-plane implementations similar to Istio, Contour, Envoy Gateway, or other Envoy/xDS\-based platforms. **Kubernetes Networking:** Strong understanding of CNI, Services, NetworkPolicy, Ingress, Gateway API, DNS, service discovery, load balancing, and pod networking. **Networking Fundamentals:** Knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, HTTP/1\.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3/QUIC, gRPC, TLS/mTLS, NAT, routing, and load balancing. **Proxy \& Application Networking :** Direct involvement in using Envoy Proxy, Contour, Istio, NGINX, HAProxy, or similar L4/L7 proxy technologies. **Linux Networking:** Experience fixing network namespaces, routing tables, iptables/nftables, sockets, conntrack, DNS, and packet\-level traffic flows. **Cloud Networking:** Experience with networking in at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure. **Infrastructure Automation:** Experience with GitOps, Argo CD, Helm, and CI/CD automation. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing or contributing to a custom Envoy\-based control plane. Experience with Envoy xDS APIs (LDS, RDS, CDS, EDS) and dynamic configuration management. Experience with Contour, Istio, Envoy Gateway, Gateway API, or similar application\-networking platforms. Experience developing Kubernetes CRDs, controllers, operators, admission webhooks, or API extensions. Hands\-on experience with Cilium based networking. Experience operating networking infrastructure across large multi\-cluster and multi\-region Kubernetes environments. Experience with Hubble, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing, or network\-flow analytics. jobs.title: Developer DBA
jobs.description: **Aeroflow Health – Developer DBA** Aeroflow Health is a national leader in home medical equipment and clinical services. We combine technology, operational excellence, and compassionate expertise to deliver essential products and care directly to patients’ homes. At Aeroflow Health, we make healthcare accessible by taking a holistic approach to how we care for our patients. We are equally passionate about taking care of our employees. Recognized as one of the fastest\-growing healthcare companies in the U.S., an Inc. 5000 honoree, and a certified Great Place to Work®, Aeroflow continues to seek ways to be one of the nation’s top employers. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to building an exceptional workplace where talented professionals are empowered, supported, and inspired to make a meaningful impact every day. **The Opportunity** Aeroflow’s Internal SQL Engineering team is comprised of approximately 10 SQL Engineers and works closely with our Database Administration, Application Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Product teams. The team owns the database logic, schema architecture, and T\-SQL development behind business\-critical internal applications and customer\-facing web systems. We are seeking a **Developer DBA** who can help define what great database engineering looks like at Aeroflow. This is not a traditional production DBA role centered primarily on backups, recovery, or disaster planning. Instead, this position sits at the intersection of senior SQL engineering, database architecture, code quality, and technical mentorship. You’ll help establish engineering standards, review and improve SQL code, guide architectural decisions, and modernize our database environment thoughtfully—without treating “new” as automatically better than stable, maintainable, and valuable. **Hybrid candidates are preferred; however, remote candidates will absolutely be considered and are encouraged to apply.** For a remote hire, we anticipate more frequent travel to our Asheville, NC office during the first few months to build relationships with the SQL Engineering team, with travel decreasing significantly thereafter. **Your Primary Responsibilities** As our Developer DBA, your work will generally span four key areas: * **Code Review (\~30%):** Review SQL engineering work and help establish clear standards for high\-quality, maintainable T\-SQL, database design, and development practices. * **Architecture \& Technical Consulting (\~30%):** Serve as a senior database resource to our Technology teams, helping engineers make sound decisions around schema design, implementation, performance, and database architecture. * **Coaching \& Mentoring (\~20%):** Help raise the technical capability of the SQL Engineering team through practical guidance, feedback, knowledge sharing, and technical mentorship. * **Hands\-On Development (\~20%):** Remain close to the code through T\-SQL development, jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. **About the Team** ------------------ The Product team at Airwallex is a group of passionate builders and problem\-solvers who are obsessed with crafting customer\-centric solutions that empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime. As the payments landscape undergoes its biggest paradigm shift in decades, our Payments Platform Team is expanding beyond legacy card rails to build the next\-generation infrastructure for global commerce. We combine deep technical expertise with first\-principles product thinking to design intuitive, highly scalable rails that bridge traditional fiat processing, autonomous AI execution, and stablecoin settlement. **The Role** ------------ As a Staff Product Manager – Next\-Gen Payments Infrastructure, based in our San Francisco office, you will lead the core strategic bets driving Airwallex's future processing engine. You will work across several key initiatives, such as our one\-click\-checkout tool Airi) and build out our Stablecoin Acceptance and Agentic Commerce. In this role, you won't just optimize authorization rates—you will design how AI agents buy, sell, and settle globally, seamlessly bridging fiat card networks with instant stablecoin liquidity. **What You'll Do** ------------------ You will lead high\-impact, zero\-to\-one and scale initiatives across three core payment vectors: 1\. Agentic Commerce \& Autonomous Payments Architecture * Define Machine\-to\-Machine Payment Protocols: Build standard API/SDK primitives and execution layers enabling AI agents to programmatically initiate, authorize, and verify payment transactions without manual human friction. * Integrate Airi into Core Payments: Partner with our AI/ML engineering teams to deploy Airi across the checkout lifecycle—utilizing LLMs and predictive models for real\-time routing, intent detection, dynamic risk scoring, and automated fraud defense. * Programmable Spending \& Identity: Architect fine\-grained authentication, spend controls, and identity verification mechanisms specifically tailored for autonomous software agents acting on behalf of businesses and consumers. 2\. Stablecoin Acceptance \& Hybrid Settlement * On\-Ramp / Off\-Ramp Orchestration: Architect robust stablecoin (USDC, USDT, etc.) payment acceptance rails, enabling merchants to accept digital dollars globally with instant, low\-cost clearing and automated conversion into local fiat currencies. * Unified Checkout Infrastructure: Embed stablecoin payment flows natively alongside traditional payment methods (Card Schemes, Local Payment Methods) within our single API integration, giving merchants zero\-friction access to Web3 liquidity. * Capital Efficiency \& Treasury Integration: Collaborate with Treasury and Liquidity Risk teams to leverage stablecoins for instant cross\-border merchant payouts and balance\-sheet optimization. 3\. Scalability, Resilience \& Industry Leadership * Build Next\-Gen Foundations: Ensure our underlying payment engines scale to handle massive transaction volumes with 99\.999% uptime, strict fault tolerance, and near\-zero latency. * Drive Ecosystem Standards: Represent Airwallex in global standards bodies, scheme working groups, and developer communities defining protocol specs for agentic commerce and crypto\-fiat settlement. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional experience in Product Management, with significant exposure to high\-growth, fast\-paced fintech or tech environments. * Proven track record building and scaling core payment infrastructure, acquiring products, card scheme integrations, or blockchain/stablecoin payment systems. * Strong technical background with a Bachelor's degree or higher (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field). ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep Domain Expertise: Hands\-on experience with payment authorization flows, ISO 8583/20022 messaging, card scheme rules, or blockchain\-based token standards (ERC\-20, Solana SPL) and stablecoin architecture. * AI \& Agentic Systems Native: Demonstrated understanding of LLMs, tool\-use agents, multi\-agent workflows, and how software agents interact with APIs to execute real\-world economic actions. Familiarity and interest in agentic commerce and payment standards and protocols, like x402, A2A, AP2, and UCP. * Technical Mastery: Exceptional capability to engage in deep architectural discussions with principal engineers, review API contracts, and evaluate transaction protocols. * First\-Principles Thinking: Ability to decompose highly complex, unstructured problems (like autonomous machine payments) into clear, execution\-focused product roadmaps. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. jobs.title: Principal Applied Scientist, WW Fulfillment by Amazon - Global Supply Chain & Economics Science
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a service that enables sellers to outsource supply chain and fulfillment to Amazon and use Amazon's world\-class science, technology, and logistics infrastructure to deliver billions of products from manufacturing hubs to customers worldwide with fast delivery promise. As FBA expands into end\-to\-end supply chain and fulfillment management, the science problems are growing in complexity and strategic importance. The FBA organization is looking for a Principal Applied Scientist with deep expertise in Operations Research, Reinforcement Learning, and strong modeling and analytical skills to join our cross\-domain group of applied scientists, research scientists, economists, and data scientists building the intelligence layer for FBA's supply chain. As a lead Principal Applied Scientist, you will own the science strategy and execution for the optimization algorithms that power FBA's supply chain, spanning the full journey from the moment a seller procures product at origin, through upstream warehousing and distribution, and into Amazon's fulfillment network. Working with a team of scientists, your technical challenges will span product selection optimization for capacity\-constrained speed nodes, balancing demand coverage, profitability, and speed sensitivity across hundreds of sites; multi\-echelon inventory optimization across a tiered architecture spanning origin\-country warehousing, destination\-country distribution centers, and regional fulfillment centers; auction mechanisms that allocate scarce capacity to sellers efficiently; seller recommendation systems that deliver explainable, economically quantified guidance; and adoption of frontier AI approaches to accelerate science delivery across the team. Your work will directly shape how millions of products flow from factory floor to customer door for millions of sellers, and your algorithms will determine the economic viability of Amazon's fastest\-growing fulfillment investments. We are looking for a seasoned scientist who brings rigorous operations research thinking to large\-scale supply chain problems, and who thrives in the ambiguity of defining the roadmap rather than receiving it. The problems above also draw on reinforcement learning for sequential, non\-stationary decisions; machine learning for the prediction and estimation layer; and mechanism design for incentive design and auctions. Beyond individual contribution, you will set the long\-term technical vision across work streams, influence product managers, engineers, scientists, and senior leaders on high\-judgment decisions, and mentor junior scientists. We value deeply technical people who deliver results incrementally and frequently in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment, and who are eager to learn new areas and develop themselves and their colleagues. Key job responsibilities * Own the science strategy and development of inventory routing, replenishment, product selection, mechanism design, and transportation distribution algorithms that power FBA's supply chain across Amazon's fulfillment network. * Design and implement large\-scale optimization algorithms and incentive\-compatible mechanisms for marketplace challenges, including auction design and pricing strategies. * Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to translate ambiguous business challenges into well\-scoped science initiatives, and build and deploy production\-grade solutions that operate reliably at scale across a network serving millions of sellers. * Influence senior leaders on technical and business direction, identify and propose new science investment areas, and represent the science perspective across organizations. * Mentor and develop junior scientists, raise the technical bar for the broader science community, and drive adoption of emerging research methods across the team. A day in the life In this role, you will be a technical leader in operations research and optimization with significant scope, impact, and high visibility. Your solutions will lead to billions of dollars of impact on either the topline or the bottom line of Amazon's third\-party seller business. You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and other Scientists to deeply understand FBA seller business problems and priorities. You will design and launch new systems, solving real\-world inventory, transportation, replenishment, pricing, and mechanism design problems with millions of unique products involving hundreds of thousands of Selling Partners and tens of millions of customers around the world. As a scientist on the team, you will be involved in every aspect of the process — from idea generation, business analysis, and scientific research, through to development and deployment of production\-grade optimization models — giving you a real sense of ownership. You are expected to make decisions about methodology, model architecture, and technology  science community at Amazon to broaden the horizon of your work and mentor scientists. About the team Sellers play a vital role in Amazon’s ecosystem, integral to our mission of offering the Earth’s largest selection, lowest prices, and fastest delivery speed. FBA is an optional service that enables third\-party sellers to outsource order fulfillment to Amazon, and leverage Amazon’s world\-class facilities to provide customers fast delivery promise. With commitment to taking on even more of the supply chain and operational complexities on behalf of our selling partners, Amazon now provides an end\-to\-end suite of supply chain and fulfillment services. This comprehensive solution empowers sellers to reliably transport products from manufacturing sites to customers worldwide. The FBA team is the core group in charge of warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment and pricing, and a diverse range of recommendation services for sellers, as well as building the internal resource management systems. We work to learn seller behavior, understand seller experience, recommend right actions to sellers, design seller policies and incentives, and develop science products and services that empower sellers to grow their businesses. To do so, we build and innovate science solutions that leverage the right tools across different fields including operations research, economics, machine learning, statistics, and data analytics. Our culture is centered on rapid prototyping, rigorous experimentation, and data\-driven decision\-making. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Where will Amazon's growth come from next year? In five years? Which product lines are staged to quintuple in size, and which ones are mature? Our systems are built entirely in\-house, and represent the forefront of automated large scale supply chain planning and optimization systems.. SCOT LTPF is responsible for long\-term forecasting and planning across Topline, Inventory, and Capacity — helping Amazon plan key metrics including ordered units and GMS, inventory units and cost, and FC building capacity and topology (size and location).
