jobs.title: AI Engineer | Digital Products & AI
jobs.description: **Company Description** We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands. *PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life* **Job Description** This practice is built for the way enterprise software *actually* gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses. As an AI Engineer, you'll work directly with clients to shape, design and build those solutions. Working alongside Product Strategists and Data Engineers, you'll take products from discovery through deployment, combining technical depth with a practical understanding of what clients need to achieve. On some engagements, we continue to run what we've built, giving you the opportunity to stay close to the product and see the impact of your work long after go\-live. This is a hands\-on engineering role. Most of the code here is written by agents. That does not make this a supervision job. It moves the engineering upstream, where strong engineering judgment becomes even more important. You'll write code, review agent\-generated outputs, and shape the architecture, controls and acceptance criteria that determine whether a solution succeeds in production. Requirements do not always arrive fully formed, and part of the role is helping define the problem while continuing to move delivery forward. **As part of the Digital Products \& AI team, you can expect to:** * Architect the elements that determine whether AI solutions succeed in production, including tool selection, memory and context management, guardrail design, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build and deploy the technical components that power agentic systems, including retrieval pipelines, MCP services and integrations, and the systems that connect AI capabilities to enterprise data and processes. * Modernize platforms and applications around current business needs, rebuilding where necessary rather than simply moving legacy functionality onto newer technology. * Design security and operational resilience into solutions from the start, including access controls, identity management, deployment guardrails, and oversight of automated actions. * Break down complex problems into deliverable components, helping shape scope, sequencing, and implementation approaches that enable rapid delivery. * Create reusable patterns, skills, and tooling that strengthen future engagements and contribute to the growth of the capability. **Qualifications** You have a track record of designing, building, and delivering complex technology solutions in production environments. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work. **To be successful, you'll have:** * **Engineering foundations** + Experience building and operating production software. Client\-facing technical delivery experience is expected at senior levels. + Strong software engineering skills, ideally including Python and TypeScript. + Experience designing and delivering cloud\-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP. * **AI engineering** + Hands\-on experience building AI applications and agent\-based systems in production. Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies, and the judgment to know when an orchestration layer earns its complexity. + Experience building retrieval\-enabled systems and working with technologies such as pgvector, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch, with an understanding of the trade\-offs between retrieval quality, latency, and cost. * **Enterprise delivery** + Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, data platforms, APIs, identity providers, and MCP\-enabled services. + Strong technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while working directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, balancing delivery speed with quality, security, and long\-term maintainability. **Ideally, you'll also bring:** * Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or time as a technical founder. * Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries. * Experience building reusable platforms, tooling, or AI solutions in regulated environments. **Additional Information** Hybrid working \- our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work. Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self. Find out more about Life at PA here. We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well\-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits: * Group medical insurance * Health Savings Account with company match * Teladoc and informed Nurse line resources * Long term care plan * Group dental insurance * Vision plan * 401(k) Savings Plan with company profit sharing contribution * Commuter and Parking tax\-savings benefit * 15 days paid vacation days with the opportunity to buy five additional days * 10 paid Holidays plus 10 paid sick days * Company and Voluntary income protection benefits * Gym and health incentive reimbursement * Pet and legal insurance Plans * Employee Assistance Plan * Annual performance\-based bonus We’re committed to advancing equality. We recruit, retain, reward and develop our people based solely on their abilities and contributions and without reference to their age, background, disability, genetic information, parental or family status, religion or belief, race, ethnicity, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity (or expression), political belief veteran status, or other by any other range of human difference brought about by identity and experience. We welcome applications from underrepresented groups. Adjustments or accommodations \- Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us on recruitmentenquiries@paconsulting.com

jobs.title: Development Manufacturing Engineer I

The Development Manufacturing Engineering I evaluates, selects, and applies exciting engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in developing and implementing adaptations and modifications on the production line and to quality systems. **Specific Duties and Responsibilities** * Solve problems and implement innovative solutions. \* * Execute detailed root cause analysis and recommend vetted solutions. \* * Communicate and explain problems and solutions cross\-functionally and interdepartmentally. \* * Approach problems from a detail\-oriented perspective. \* * Support production; Creating and maintaining product and process documentation; Monitor process and equipment performance and identify and implement process improvement activities to increase/optimize yield, efficiency, and/or throughput. \* * Design fixtures, acquire off\-the\-shelf tooling and equipment, and implement new fixtures on the production line. Materials, or Industrial Engineering or related degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience Additional qualifications: * 1\+ year relevant engineering experience preferred * Engineering experience in a manufacturing environment recommended, medical device industry preferred * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills required * Knowledge of FDA jobs.title: Backend Systems Engineer (Python/C++)
jobs.description: We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly analytical Junior Systems Software Engineer to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize low\-level application architecture, networking protocols, and performance\-critical systems. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, hands\-on experience with C\+\+ and Python, and a passion for building responsive, scalable software. **Key Responsibilities:** · **Systems \& Network Architecture:** Design, implement, and maintain custom networking components, client\-server models, and protocol resolvers (UDP/TCP, DNS, socket communications). · **Algorithm \& Performance Optimization:** Apply data structures, memory management, and graph search heuristics (e.g., A\*, custom hashing, priority queues) to solve complex performance and indexing challenges. · **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Develop and execute comprehensive unit, integration, and stress tests to validate network state synchronization, catch edge cases, and eliminate execution bottlenecks. · **Debugging \& Problem Solving:** Utilize low\-level debugging tools (GDB, Wireshark) to trace memory leaks, analyze packet flow, and debug asynchronous multi\-threaded or multi\-client execution paths. · **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional teams to design clean, modular codebases and maintain version control integrity across all release cycles. **Key Requirements:** · **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (GPA 3\.5\+ preferred). · **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **C\+\+** and **Python** . Familiarity with C, C\#, Java, SQL, or x86 Assembly is a plus. · **Systems \& Networking:** Solid understanding of TCP/UDP networking principles, socket programming, caching mechanisms, operating systems, and computer architecture. · **Tools \& Environment:** Hands\-on experience with **Linux/Bash** , **Git/GitHub** , **GDB** , and **Wireshark** . Experience with SFML, Unity, or VR/AR engines is desirable. · **CS Fundamentals:** Proven command of object\-oriented design, algorithmic complexity, recursive problem\-solving, and concurrent state management. **Desired Competencies:** · Self\-starter capable of managing end\-to\-end projects—from requirement mapping to comprehensive testing. · Passion for interactive media, high\-performance computing, or game engine mechanics. · Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and code reviews.

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a team of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future. **The team** This role is part of the Runtime team, but will include deep collaboration with the Research, Hardware, and Fleet teams. **In this role you will:** * Drive the architecture and implementation of embedded firmware for devices crucial to PI’s data collection goals * Work with hardware and software teams to ensure the new devices we are building work seamlessly with existing and future data pipelines * Embedded Linux System Bring\-up: Lead the integration of embedded Linux devices with real\-time sensor processing. This includes developing drivers for high\-speed sensors, BSP development and customization, kernel configuration and debugging, hardware bring\-up, and performance tuning across the hardware/software boundary. * Hardware/Software Debugging: Use hardware abstraction tools and laboratory equipment to identify and resolve complex timing issues, race conditions, and hardware\-software interface bugs. * Power Optimization: Analyze and reduce power consumption for battery\-operated devices, including on radio sleep states and sensor low\-power modes. **What we hope you'll bring:** * BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. * Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills, including building data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and tools for rapid iteration. * Comfort working hands\-on with hardware. * Strong communication skills for collaborating with hardware, software, and research teams * Demonstrated experience leading initiatives from concept to production on aggressive schedules, and turning ambiguous product goals into functional requirements * Experience leading initial board bring\-up and software design for first\-of\-their\-kind embedded devices. * Hands\-on experience with SPI, I2C, UART, USB, and the ability to debug complex hardware\-software interactions. * Experience architecting, implementing and debugging concurrent and multithreaded firmware services * Deep understanding of modern operating systems, computer architecture, and trade\-offs between compute, memory, and storage. * Experience bringing up and integrating sensors on embedded systems; camera system bring\-up, integration, and tuning is a plus. * Proficiency in C\+\+ * Familiarity with Bash scripting and Python for tooling and automation. **Bonus points if you have:** * Nice to have: Direct experience with Linux Kernel development, including writing or debugging drivers, managing device trees, or optimizing kernel\-space performance. *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer - Snowflake & dbt Cloud
jobs.description: Are you looking for a forward focus environment where you are continually challenged, and the atmosphere is affirming? Do you want to be a part of a team where you are often out of your comfort zone, but you wake up excited to go to work each day? How about a place where people are growing because they desire change and growth is modeled and expected? **WHO WE ARE:** Premier Trailer Leasing is a '**USA Today Top Workplace**' and one of the largest trailer leasing and rental companies in the nation, specializing in long\-term leasing and short\-term rental services for over\-the\-road vans, flatbeds, refrigerated equipment and chassis with an inventory of 70,000 trailers and a growing network of locations across the United States. At Premier you will find an environment where you are seen, heard and valued. Join us and experience what it means to live a culture of C.A.R.E! **JOB SCOPE:** Premier Trailer Leasing is building its next\-generation Enterprise Data Platform to support its continued growth as part of a hybrid data modernization plan. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for an experienced Snowflake builder. You will help design and implement a greenfield Snowflake environment, establish the engineering practices surrounding it, and deliver governed, production\-grade data products supporting reporting, operational integrations, APIs, and future AI workloads. We are looking for someone who has built and operated this kind of platform before, brings practical lessons from prior implementations, takes ownership, and constructively challenges technical assumptions. As the platform and team grow, you will establish the standards and patterns future data engineers will follow. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Greenfield Platform Build:** Partner with Data Leadership to design and implement a modern data platform using Snowflake, dbt Cloud, managed ingestion and CDC tooling, appropriate custom integrations, and GitHub\-based workflows. * **Engineering Standards \& Operating Model:** Establish repeatable practices for environments, Git workflows, modular development, testing, code review, CI/CD, deployment controls, rollback, documentation, monitoring, access, and production support. * **Data Architecture \& Modeling:** Build a layered architecture spanning raw ingestion, conformed enterprise models, and published marts or data products. Design canonical models that standardize core business entities, definitions, relationships, and rules. * **Ingestion \& CDC:** Design and operate resilient ingestion patterns for SQL Server, ERP, CRM, SaaS applications, REST APIs, files, and semi\-structured data using managed CDC and ingestion platforms alongside custom integrations where appropriate. * **Legacy Decoupling:** Work with Data Leadership and the SQL Server team to profile legacy sources, inventory dependencies, identify data\-quality risks, reconcile existing outputs, and migrate consumers from direct source\-system access to governed data products. * **Quality, Reliability \& Observability:** Establish automated testing, reconciliation, freshness monitoring, schema\-change controls, CDC\-lag monitoring, alerting, failure handling, retry and replay patterns, runbooks, and production support expectations. * **Security, Cost \& Performance:** Design Snowflake environments, roles, service accounts, access patterns, workload isolation, monitoring, and consumption controls that support least privilege, auditability, performance, and responsible cloud spend. * **Data Delivery:** Publish governed data products for Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, internal and customer\-facing APIs, custom applications, and a DBA\-managed SQL Server serving layer for approved legacy and latency\-sensitive consumers. * **Technical Ownership \& Collaboration:** Serve as the technical lead for the platform, owning technical quality, production readiness, design patterns, documentation, and platform stability while collaborating with Data Leadership and the data team, as well as infrastructure, security, and application teams. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS:** * **Proven Greenfield Snowflake Experience:** 7\+ years of progressive data engineering or data platform experience, including substantial hands\-on responsibility for at least one production greenfield Snowflake implementation or major platform modernization into Snowflake. * **Deep Snowflake Experience:** Practical expertise with Snowflake architecture, warehouse and workload design, RBAC, security, cost governance, performance tuning, semi\-structured data, monitoring, and production operations. * **dbt Cloud Expertise:** Hands\-on experience establishing and operating dbt Cloud with GitHub for modular transformation development, testing, lineage, documentation, environment management, CI, and production deployment. * **Production Pipeline Ownership:** Experience designing and operating resilient ingestion, CDC, transformation, and delivery pipelines, including schema drift, freshness, reconciliation, failure recovery, retry, replay, and incident response. * **Data Modeling \& Quality:** Expertise designing conformed enterprise models, dimensional marts, and durable canonical data products supported by automated testing and data\-quality controls. * **Software Engineering Practices:** Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Git and GitHub workflows, automated testing, code review, modular development, CI/CD, and controlled production releases. * **Security, Governance \& Cost Discipline:** Experience establishing practical access controls, environment separation, service\-account and secrets patterns, auditability, production\-change controls, and consumption monitoring. * **Pragmatic Technical Leadership:** A hands\-on builder who communicates tradeoffs clearly, challenges assumptions constructively, and takes ownership of reliability, maintainability, documentation, and production delivery. * **Location:** Must be based in, or willing to commute to, the Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week. **PREFERRRED EXPERIENCE:** * Experience migrating or decoupling consumers from legacy Microsoft SQL Server environments into Snowflake. * Experience with SQL Server CDC and near\-real\-time ingestion. * Experience with Dynamics GP, enterprise CRM systems, or similarly complex operational platforms. * Experience with Azure Blob Storage, semi\-structured documents, images, or other unstructured data. * Experience with reverse ETL, operational data delivery, customer\-facing data APIs, or application integrations. * Experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish a growing data engineering function. **TECH STACK:** * **Primary Platform:** Snowflake * **Transformation, Testing \& Lineage:** dbt Cloud * **Source Control \& CI/CD:** GitHub, GitHub Actions, dbt Cloud CI * **Ingestion \& CDC:** Managed ingestion platform, SQL Server CDC, REST APIs, files, and custom integrations * **Primary Sources:** SQL Server, Dynamics GP (ERP), CRM, SaaS applications, Azure Blob Storage, APIs, and semi\-structured data * **Consumers:** Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, APIs, custom applications, SQL Server serving layers, and future AI and machine\-learning workloads

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Proton is building the AI operating system for wholesale distribution, embedded in the workflows that move nearly every physical product on the planet. Distribution is a $9 trillion industry running on software that has been stuck for decades. We unify CRM, PIM, eCommerce AI, and Order \& Quote Entry AI into one platform with one data layer and one AI brain, so reps spend their time on customer relationships instead of data entry. We have been building AI into distribution since 2018, long before it became an industry buzzword. That head start matters, and we've only deepened the investment: in 2025 we shipped the first AI assistant embedded in a distribution CRM and launched a complete agentic product in our PIM offering. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. Everyone here is a builder who owns problems end to end and ships AI\-native software faster than anyone else in the category. The median Proton customer reports 3x profit return per dollar spent and an extra day of sales per rep per month. Hundreds of distributors run on Proton, from family\-owned shops to publicly\-traded enterprises. We're backed by Felicis Ventures and Battery Ventures. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring a Product Manager to own product domains end to end. Reporting to the VP of Product, you'll lead a multi\-functional squad at the intersection of AI capability and real distributor workflows, turning our positioning advantage into compounding product differentiation. End to end means further than it usually does. You inherit a problem space rather than a backlog: work out where the real value sits across hundreds of distributors, ship in tight cycles with design partners keeping you honest, prove the thing works in production, then drive adoption across the base and make it something sales can sell without you. There is no handoff point where the domain stops being yours. **Location:** Cambridge, MA. Hybrid, 3 days a week in our Harvard Square office. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own your domain from fuzzy to growth.** Take an ambiguous problem space through discovery, definition, build, launch, adoption, and revenue. You are responsible for the outcome. * **Get onsite, constantly.** Distributors work in warehouses and on sales floors. Onsite visits, shadowing sessions, and discovery calls are how you learn the domain, and the best calls come from standing next to a rep. Our product people know their users by name. * **Run genuinely iterative development with customers in the loop.** Think big, ship small, put working software in front of real users early, and let what you learn reset the next cycle. Design the feedback loop deliberately rather than waiting for feedback to arrive. * **Build hands\-on with engineering, design, and data science** to ship features and agentic workflows, and to make sure the surrounding UX lets a user act on what AI surfaces. * **Own adoption, not just launch.** Run alphas and betas, stay close through the first rollouts, then push adoption across the installed base and watch where it stalls and why. * **Enable GTM.** Give sales and CS the positioning, proof, and training they need. Join customer and prospect calls, show the product yourself when it helps, and make sure what you built is sellable and supportable without you in the room. **What You'll Need to Succeed** ------------------------------- * **Product and startup experience.** At least 2 years managing features end\-to\-end through the SDLC. Early\-stage startup experience (Seed through B or C) is a plus. * **Real agile experience, and the judgment to adapt it.** You've worked inside traditional scrum, know what those rituals were for, and can run a tight iterative loop with customers rather than a release calendar. You've shipped something incomplete on purpose because it was the fastest way to learn. * **Technical and AI collaboration.** You've built alongside engineers and data scientists to deploy AI\-centric features at scale, and you're fluent enough to hold your own with senior engineers on data models, APIs, and service boundaries. * **Daily, hands\-on use of AI in your own practice.** Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent, used to ship real work rather than generate artifacts. You can say concretely how you structure context and how you check what comes back. * **Customer\-facing range.** You're as comfortable in a warehouse aisle with a rep as on a call with a VP of Sales, and you can carry a room in front of a prospect. You'd rather be with a user than briefed about them. * **Data\-driven and adaptive thinking.** You make data\-driven calls while embracing the uncertainty earlier\-stage vertical B2B SaaS brings. * **Problem\-solving and communication.** You navigate complexity, distill the key issue, and communicate clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. * **Business sense and a continuous improvement mindset.** Strong business intuition and a real appetite for innovation, iteration, and AI excellence. **Big Plus** ------------ * Complex B2B, enterprise, or ERP\-adjacent software, with high\-frequency users and workflows people can't opt out of. * Agentic products, and the patterns for trust, correction, and handoff between a person and an agent. * Systems\-of\-record or integrations work. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Urgently hiring***, we're growing fast and we need engineers as soon as possible! This could be you! We make a **commitment** to try and get back to all applicants **within 5 business days**. The interview process is also relatively straightforward: * A brief technical screen \+ product\-related questions. * A flight and accommodations to NYC for a 1\.5 hour interview comprised of a 1\-hour final technical component and a 30 min behavioral chat afterwards. We move *fast*, we hire remotely and hybrid, but we prefer in\-person in NYC. If you get the position we will happily work with you to pay a significant relocation bonus and help you find a lease (via our 3rd\-party placement services in NYC who will literally advise and help you tour apartments all day). **SAJA** is a venture\-backed startup funded by top investors. We're building a new way to collect, trade, and engage with physical collectibles through a digital\-first experience. We're growing rapidly so we're looking for a Software Engineer with 0\-3 years of experience to help us build and ship the product, primarily on iOS, with room to work across the stack as you grow. **What you'll do** * Build and ship features in our iOS app, from the pack\-opening experience to collection management to payments. * Work across the stack when a feature needs it, including the TypeScript backend that powers the app. * Take features from a rough idea to something in front of real users, and stay with them after launch. * Debug issues in production, including the ones that only show up on real devices and real networks. * Work with design, product, and the rest of engineering to figure out what's worth building and what it should actually do. * Help us make good decisions about testing, reliability, and how we handle anything that touches money. **What we're looking for** * Strong fundamentals in at least one language, and the ability to pick up others quickly. We use Swift and SwiftUI on iOS and TypeScript on the backend, but we care far more that you can learn a stack than that you already know ours. * Some experience building something real, whether that's a personal project, an internship, or coursework you took further than required. We'd rather see one thing you shipped and can talk about in depth than a long list of technologies. * The instinct to figure out why something is broken rather than trying fixes until one works. * Ability to take an underspecified problem and ask the right questions before writing code. * Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and knowing when to ask instead. * Interest in consumer products, marketplaces, gaming, collectibles, fintech, or e\-commerce. * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment with significant ownership. * Strong ability to be AI\-forward with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and a yearly $100k token budget allotted to you. **What this job is actually like** You'll ship to production early, in your first couple of weeks. You'll work across most of the product rather than one corner of it, and you'll have someone senior to learn from while you do. It moves quickly, the codebase is young, and you'll have real influence over how things get built. Although preferred, you do not need experience in collectibles or trading cards, or prior iOS experience if you're a strong engineer elsewhere. We care much more about your ability to think critically, learn quickly, and build things that work. **Location** We're headquartered in NYC and most of the team is here, but we hire remote and hybrid. If you're in the city, you'll find people in the office everyday. If you're not, we make sure you're not a second\-class participant, and we'll fly you in regularly so you get real time with the team. **Compensation** $200,000–$300,000 base, plus meaningful early\-stage equity (0\.5\-2%). The range reflects real differences in experience and demonstrated ability. We'll tell you where we think you land and why. Additional equity compensation a serious part of the offer, not a rounding error, and we're happy to walk you through the numbers so you can actually evaluate it. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision, with premiums fully covered for you and heavily subsidized for dependents * 401(k) * Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents * Top\-spec laptop, monitors, and whatever else makes you effective; home office stipend if you're remote * $100k annual AI token budget, plus a small learning and conference budget * Commuter benefits for NYC\-based folks * Regular offsites and team dinners * Lunch provided in the office Even if you do not meet all the qualifications, feel free to apply if you think there might be a role for you at SAJA. Drive and passion are by far our favorite markers for success. **Please do not apply to multiple roles within Saja. We will automatically consider you for other roles, but please apply to only one role.** Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Gym membership * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Pet insurance * Relocation assistance * Unlimited paid time off * Visa sponsorship * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10007

jobs.title: Graphic Design Co-op (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: **About SHP** At SHP, design is about more than buildings\-it's about people. We create places where students learn, communities gather, and organizations thrive. Our work is collaborative by nature, bringing together architects, interior designers, and engineers who care deeply about both design excellence and the human experience. As a co\-op, you'll be part of that team. You'll gain hands\-on project experience, learn from mentors who are invested in your growth, and build connections with peers across disciplines. Most importantly, you'll see how your ideas and contributions make a real impact on the communities we serve. As a Graphic Design Co\-op, you'll join our business services team and help shape how we tell our story through design and copy. From eye\-catching graphics to thoughtful event branding and creative communications, you'll get hands\-on experience blending design, writing, and strategy to engage audiences inside and outside the firm. **What You'll Do** * Design and write content for graphics, presentations, and campaigns that support both internal and external communications. * Create visual assets for events, social media, and digital platforms while sharpening your design and branding skills. * Assist with planning and setting up events, making sure messaging and visuals feel seamless and on\-brand. * Contribute to employer branding and culture initiatives with fresh ideas and creative execution. * Collaborate across departments and learn how design and communication come together to build strong engagement. **Who You Are** * Junior or Senior or Graduate student in Business, Marketing or Communications. * Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and user\-friendly platforms such as Canva for social media content * Strong design eye, detail\-oriented, and eager to learn **How We Work (Our Values)** * **Be Curious** – Dive into problems and seek innovative solutions. * **Be Bold** – Contribute ideas and challenge yourself. * **Be Selfless** – Collaborate openly with teammates and clients. * **Be Grateful** – Value mentorship and shared learning. * **Be Accountable** – Deliver reliable, thoughtful work. **Location \& Travel Expectations** This role is based in one of our physical office locations\-Cincinnati, OH; Columbus, OH; or Greensboro, NC\-and is ideal for candidates who thrive in a highly collaborative, in person environment. Being onsite allows for deeper day to day engagement with peers and project teams, faster decision making, and organic moments of creativity and mentorship that emerge through shared space. **Compensation \& Benefits** Your growth matters here \- our pay reflects both your contributions and your potential. Our co\-op positions start at $20/hour, with the opportunity to increase by $1/hour for each additional term you return (up to a maximum of $22/hour). Graduate students begin at $22/hour. SHP also covers your parking expenses, so you can focus fully on gaining meaningful experience without worrying about the cost of getting here. At SHP, our compensation philosophy reflects our values \- we believe in recognizing growth, rewarding contribution, and aligning pay with the market. For our co\-ops, that means your time here is not only meaningful for your development, but also valued in a way that reflects the impact you have on our work and the potential we see in you. *SHP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.*

ods, material and tools used to troubleshoot, maintain and repair sprinkler and fire alarm systems, elevators and switch gear and electrical distribution systems. * Working knowledge of the methods, jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data & Observability Platforms — MTS/SMTS
jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **Job Summary** --------------- We’re hiring a Software Engineer at either the Member of Technical Staff (MTS) or Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) level to join the IT Employee Success (ES) \& Finance Platform, Data and Innovations team. The final level will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, technical depth, demonstrated scope, and leadership capabilities. Our team builds the platforms that power Employee Success and Finance systems. We’re evolving our observability capabilities beyond traditional dashboards and reactive alerts toward intelligent, agent\-assisted operations—including proactive issue detection, root\-cause analysis, and insights informed by historical telemetry. We’re also building a unified data platform that integrates data from Workday, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems to support operational workflows, reporting, analytics, and emerging AI and agentic use cases. This role is a strong fit for an engineer with a platform\-first mindset and experience in—or a strong interest in—data platforms, telemetry, observability, cloud infrastructure, and open\-source technologies. **About the Role** ------------------ You’ll be a hands\-on technical contributor building reliable, reusable, and scalable platform capabilities for Employee Success and Finance systems. At the MTS level, you’ll contribute to the design and implementation of platform components, collaborate with experienced engineers, and take increasing ownership of services and technical outcomes. At the SMTS level, you’ll lead the design of significant platform capabilities, drive technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and influence the long\-term architecture and direction of the platform. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and operate telemetry, observability, logging, and alerting systems that provide real\-time visibility into system health, reliability, and performance. * Advance our observability platform beyond dashboards and reactive monitoring toward proactive, AI\- and agent\-assisted issue detection, investigation, and root\-cause analysis. * Build and evolve data pipelines and platform services that integrate data from Workday, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. * Enable operational, reporting, analytics, and emerging AI and agentic use cases through reliable, secure, and well\-governed data. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines with integrated quality gates, including automated testing, security scanning, and vulnerability checks. * Develop scalable and maintainable infrastructure and services using open\-source technologies, primarily on AWS, with some workloads on GCP. * Partner with Employee Success, Finance, security, data, and other engineering teams to identify platform gaps and improve developer experience, data reliability, and operational intelligence. * Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning. * Apply and promote engineering best practices related to code quality, testing, security, reliability, and operational excellence. * Contribute to reusable technical patterns, standards, and documentation across the platform. **Core Qualifications** ----------------------- * Professional software development experience building and operating production systems. * Proficiency in one or more relevant programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Go. * Experience with—or a strong interest in—observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, data pipelines, or data platforms. * Familiarity with open\-source technologies and modern software engineering practices. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and foundational security or vulnerability\-management practices. * Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS; GCP experience is a plus. * Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and system\-design principles. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business teams. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **L rating Workday, Salesforce, or other enterprise and third\-party systems. * Experience with MuleSoft or a similar enterprise integration platform. * Experience with Kubernetes or another container\-orchestration platform. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Posting Statement Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. governance standards across SharePoint and related Microsoft 365 applications. * Optimize performance, reliability, and usability of existing SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power BI solutions through Automation Design Specifications and drawings - Product configurations - Factory testing and procedures - Field safety preparations and commissioning procedures - Service reports + Technical lead of the project engineering team that will define deliverables, schedule, and project execution from design through commissioning.**This position will consider candidates from an Associate or Engineering I level.** **This job might be for you if:** + Understanding of project engineering scope in relation to project budget (labor and equipment) + Ownership of schedule and a self\-starter for research + Professional communication skills to be the direct technical contact for customers and colleagues. + Designing of control logic schemes and network configurations + Ability to analyze electrical one\-line drawings, DC/AC Schematics, and Bill of Materials + Experience with industry standard communication protocols (IEC\-61850, DNP, Modbus, etc.) + Experience with server/client SCADA applications + Experience with design/development suite of HMI applications + Willing to travel at least 20% of the time domestically and abroad ***Preferred Qualifications*** + Experience with phase I/O style project management + Experience with SEL product configurations + Experience with IEC\-61131 programming + Experience with Python programming + Experience with IT/OT Network design + Experience with IT/OT Network troubleshooting (Wireshark) + Substation safety training***Multiple Locations:*** **King of Prussia, PA**\- This position is located in King of Prussia, PA. Enjoy easy access to trails along the river, or attend sporting events nearby. The diverse options make King of Prussia the perfect place to call home. **Hanover, MD**\- This position is located in Hanover, MD. Design, implement, and support identity, access, and profile\-related services for multiple web applications, supporting both internal and customer users. * Implement best practices and standards for software development, including code reviews, testing, and documentation * Mentor and coach junior team members, providing guidance and support to help them grow and succeed * Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, continuously learning and experimenting with new tools and techniques to improve our software development process * Be responsible for the services that are owned by your team, ensuring 24/7 on\-call coverage **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors office in **Fremont, CA.** * This role requires 1\-3 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. * Travel: Domestic travel required. Valid driver's license required. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. jobs.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (Applied AI)
jobs.description: **Senior Member of Technical Staff (Applied AI)** ================================================= **Location:** **New York City** =============================== **Why You Should Join Us** -------------------------- Solstice is redefining how life sciences organizations commercialize therapeutics. We are building a commercial engine that allows pharmaceutical marketers to launch campaigns at 100x the speed. Our mission is to accelerate the knowledge of life\-saving medicines. * **Rapid growth:** Over the past year, we have worked with some of the top life sciences manufacturers and over 50\+ pharma brands including Pfizer and AstraZeneca. * **A hard technical problem:** We are trying to rethink the way the largest, most innovative therapies in the world come to market. Every claim in pharma marketing content must trace to an approved source. Fair balance rules govern placement. All materials go through rigorous medical, legal, and regulatory review, which can last months. Building persuasive and defensible content is a genuine challenge, with no playbook. We have the customers and proprietary data to do this right. * **Top\-tier investors:** Our backers include Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm. * **Influence and ownership:** This senior role directly shapes our architectural future. We're seeking someone who wants responsibility, not someone who needs work handed to them. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a senior Applied AI engineer to own the technical direction of our AI systems: retrieval, generation, verification, evaluation, and keeping systems running in production. Nothing's predetermined. When there's a fork in the road, you decide. You will work closely with VP of Engineering Jay, and co\-founders Aris and Yiwen, influencing product strategy, technical hiring, and our market positioning. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * **High\-craft output:** Our clients demand work with polish, not "AI slop." Pharma assets like emails, banners, slides and leave\-behinds require both visual and textual excellence. ISI must be prominent, brand systems must endure, and hierarchy and typography must survive generation. Our job isn't just compliance. It's making sure assets don't get quietly rewritten by marketers. * **Connecting content to outcomes:** Passing MLR review means a piece can ship, but not that it worked. We'll connect generated assets to real\-world performance, including engagement, HCP response and scripts written, and use that data to improve future output. * **Evaluation where ground truth is slow:** Determining compliance is slow, coming back as reviewer redlines in inconsistent formats. Developing offline metrics that track downstream MLR pass rate is critical. * **Claim\-level attribution:** True grounding means every sentence can be traced back to a specific, defensible source. Our proprietary corpora span prescribing information, clinical data, approved assets, style guides and claim libraries, and provenance must be preserved through generation. * **ML Ops and behavioral regression:** Full CI/CD for ML, versioning, automated testing, monitoring, and the harder under\-the\-hood work. Upgrades shift output in ways easy stats can miss, and tail risks matter most. Ongoing vigilance is required. **Ideal Traits** ---------------- * **Production ownership:** Experience shipping, operating, and maintaining ML/LLM systems in production. * **Evaluation instinct:** History of inventing metrics to measure and improve systems. * **Depth in LLMs:** Retrieval, agentic pipelines, targeted fine\-tuning, and judgment on the best tool for each job. * **Full\-stack proficiency:** Python, FastAPI, Docker, AWS; able to take ideas from research to deployed service independently. * **Judgment under ambiguity:** Confident decisions amid unknowns; unafraid to be wrong and adjust fast. * **Communication:** Strong collaboration and feedback skills; direct and open style preferred. **Benefits** ------------ * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Ground\-floor equity opportunity * Visa sponsorship (O\-1, H\-1B, TN) available * Unlimited PTO * 401(k) with 4% match * In\-office lunches five days a week * Professional growth stipend * Relocation support **Compensation** ---------------- Highly competitive NYC salary: $230,000 to $350,000 depending on experience, seniority, and ownership level. We benchmark against elite startups and major tech firms, with flexibility at the top of the range for exceptional talent.

jobs.title: Staff AI Scientist, Foundation Models
jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. At Tempus, we are pursuing a mission to redefine precision medicine through data\-driven insights. The Foundation Model group is a multidisciplinary team of AI scientists and engineers developing foundation models across diverse clinical and molecular modalities, including longitudinal patient data, pathology, genomics, and other biomedical data. Our goal is to build generalizable AI representations and models that can power applications across clinical care, biomedical research, and the drug development lifecycle. As a **Staff AI Scientist, Foundation Models**, you will be a senior individual contributor focused on advancing large\-scale foundation models for precision medicine. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, clinical science, and life sciences, developing novel models using one of the world’s largest clinical and molecular datasets and translating them into impactful applications across clinical research, drug development, and partner programs. **Key Responsibilities:** * Technical Leadership: Serve as a senior individual contributor within the foundation model team, providing strong hands\-on technical contributions while helping shape model architecture, research direction, and execution. Work closely with scientists and engineers to take ambitious AI technologies from research through validation and deployment. * Foundation Model Research: Design, train, and advance state\-of\-the\-art foundation models across large\-scale multimodal clinical and molecular data, including longitudinal patient records, pathology, genomics, and related biomedical modalities. Drive innovation in areas such as pretraining, representation learning, self\-supervised learning, multimodal learning, model scaling, and post\-training. * Foundation Model Applications: Develop and adapt foundation\-model\-derived models for downstream clinical and life sciences applications, including prognosis, treatment outcome prediction, patient stratification, biomarker discovery, clinical trial applications, and partner\-specific AI solutions. * Scientific Leadership: Contribute original ideas that advance Tempus’s foundation model research agenda, publish impactful research, and engage with the broader AI research community. * Regulatory and Product Alignment: Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure models and AI products meet appropriate quality, validation, and regulatory standards for healthcare and life sciences applications. **Qualifications:** We value diverse perspectives and recognize that outstanding talent does not always follow a linear path. If you are passionate about this work and believe you have what it takes to thrive here, please apply even if you do not precisely match all the qualifications below. * Education: Ph.D. in Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. * Professional Experience: 3\+ years of industry experience driving end\-to\-end development of machine learning models, from research and experimentation to validation and production deployment. * Domain Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in large\-scale deep learning and foundation model development is required, including experience in areas such as pretraining, representation learning, self\-supervised learning, multimodal modeling, or post\-training. Experience with computer vision, NLP, pathology, longitudinal EHR, genomics, or other biomedical modalities is preferred. Prior work in medical or healthcare AI is highly valued but not required. * Research Excellence: A strong track record of original, high\-impact research demonstrated through peer\-reviewed publications in leading machine learning, computer vision, NLP, or related AI venues is required. Publications in medical or healthcare AI and prior experience developing foundation models are strongly preferred. * Engineering Excellence: Proficiency in Python and the modern deep learning stack (e.g. Pytorch). Strong product\-level coding skills for model development are essential, along with a solid understanding of industry\-standard software engineering and development practices. New York Pay Range \- $220,000 \- $260,000 USD The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **About Us** Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives. ### **Why Work Here?** We’re looking for people who can change the world. Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

jobs.description: **Software Quality Test Engineer 3** ==================================== **Date:** Sep 14, 2026 **Location:** Lakewood, CO, US **Company:** Terumo BCT, Inc. **Requisition ID:** 35445 At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies, our 8,000\+ global associates proud to come to work each day, knowing that what we do impacts the lives of patients around the world. **For Terumo, for Everyone, Everywhere.** We make medical devices and related products that are used to collect, separate, manufacture and process various components of blood and cells. With our innovative technologies and service offerings, we touch a patient’s life every second of every day and are committed to continuing to increase the number of patients we serve. **Advancing healthcare with heart.** With some of the best and brightest minds in the industry, an unmatched global footprint, comprehensive benefits and a distinct culture, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is a great place to work, grow and be part of a team that is focused on making a difference. **Join us and help shape wherever we go next. You create your future and ours.** **Software Quality Test Engineer 3** **JOB SUMMARY** The Software Quality Test Engineer 3 is responsible for ensuring the delivery of secure, compliant, and high\-quality software across both new product development and sustaining products. This role operates within a modern Software Quality Engineering model, grounded in shift\-left and continuous quality principles, with a strong focus on defect prevention, robust verification, and lifecycle traceability. The Software Quality Test Engineer 3 is responsible for designing and executing testing activities based on product requirements, risk, and regulatory expectations. This role collaborates closely with Software Development, Systems Engineering, DevOps, Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs), and global teams to ensure quality is incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle. A key focus of this role is creating high\-quality, repeatable, and traceable test cases, identifying appropriate manual and automated test approaches, and partnering with SDETs to support implementation of automation aligned with defined verification objectives. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** * Develop test plans for features, products, and releases based on requirements, risk, and intended use. * Develop and maintain comprehensive, repeatable, and traceable test cases aligned to software requirements and risk controls. * Design high\-quality test cases with clear preconditions, test steps, expected results, and automation considerations. * Identify opportunities for test automation and collaborate with SDETs to support automated test implementation. * Execute manual testing and evaluate automated test results to assess software quality and requirements compliance. * Analyze test results and investigate failures to determine whether issues are caused by software defects, test defects, or environmental conditions. * Document software defects with sufficient detail to support investigation and resolution. * Maintain traceability between requirements, risk controls, test cases, test execution results, and defects. * Participate in requirements and design reviews to provide input on quality, completeness, consistency, and testability. * Participate in software impact assessments to identify affected requirements, test cases, and areas requiring regression testing. * Support shift\-left quality practices by collaborating with development, systems, and DevOps teams throughout the development lifecycle. * Contribute to release readiness activities by ensuring verification activities are completed and documented appropriately. **OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Support continuous improvement of SQE processes, tools, and practices. * Support cybersecurity, performance, and reliability testing activities as assigned. * Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, quality system, and documentation requirements. * Collaborate with global teams to ensure test assets are understandable, maintainable, and executable across locations. * Assist in reviewing peer test cases and test artifacts for completeness and quality. * Support adoption of modern quality engineering practices and tools. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job may be considered. **Experience** * Minimum 5 years of experience in software quality engineering, software testing, or a related software engineering discipline. * Experience working within a regulated industry (e.g., medical device, aerospace, automotive, defense, or similar) preferred. **Skills** * Strong knowledge of software testing principles and quality engineering practices. * Experience developing manual and automation\-ready test cases. * Understanding of risk\-based testing methodologies. * Working knowledge of software development lifecycles, including Scrum and DevOps practices. * Experience with requirements traceability and software verification activities. * Ability to analyze test results and perform defect investigation. * Understanding of automated testing concepts and collaboration with SDETs. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Familiarity with modern test management and defect tracking tools. * Experience working effectively within cross\-functional teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Experience working with distributed and global teams. * Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. \-Or\- An equivalent competency level acquired through a variation of these qualifications may be considered. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** Hybrid position reporting to the Lakewood, CO headquarters a minimum of 3 days a week. Typical Office Environment requirements include reading, speaking, hearing, close vision, walking, bending, sitting, and occasional lifting up to 20 pounds. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties. **Target Pay Range:** $122,600\.00 to $153,300\.00 \- Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data **Target Bonus on Base:** 7\.0 We anticipate this requisition will be open for a minimum of five days, from 09/13/2026\. We encourage your prompt application. At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies, we provide competitive total reward offerings that consist of compensation, benefits, recognition, along with a wealth of other well\-being, work\-life and recognition programs which support in unlocking the potential for you and your family. Included in our expansive list of benefits offerings are multiple group medical, dental and vision plans, a robust wellness program, life insurance and disability coverages, also a variety of voluntary programs such as group accident, hospital indemnity, critical illness, pet insurance and much more. To help you save for retirement, we offer a 401(k) plan with a matching contribution and for work\-life balance we have vacation and sick time programs for associates. For us, it’s about protecting the personal welfare of our associates and their families, helping to achieve personal goals and offering those extra touches for convenience, security and overall peace of mind. **We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Affirmative Action Employer. All applicants will be afforded equal opportunity without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability unrelated to ability, military status or an unfavorable discharge from military service.** **Nearest Major Market:** Denver **Job Segment:** Testing, Test Engineer, Medical Device, Medical Device Engineer, Quality Engineer, Technology, Engineering, Healthcare

jobs.title: Quality Engineering & Release Manager
jobs.description: **Quality Engineering \& Release Manager** ========================================== **Location:** Lake Mary, FL (Hybrid) **Department:** Technology/AI, \& Product Experience **Status:** Full\-Time \| Exempt **About The IIA** ----------------- The Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) is the global leader and recognized authority for the internal audit profession. We advance the profession worldwide through education, advocacy, certifications, and professional resources. Guided by our values of People First, Integrity, Collaboration, Accountability, and Innovation, we offer a collaborative, purpose\-driven workplace where employees can grow professionally while making a global impact. **Why Join The IIA?** --------------------- * Build and shape an automated quality engineering capability from the ground up. * Take ownership of quality standards and release readiness for technology that supports a global professional organization. * Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Agile teams in a highly collaborative environment. * Help establish scalable testing, release, and change\-control practices that improve software quality and reliability. * Join a values\-driven organization committed to innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. **Position Summary** -------------------- The Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) is seeking a **Manager,** **Quality Engineering \& Release** to build and own our automated quality engineering capability and the release gate that capability makes possible. This is a hands\-on build role for an experienced quality engineering professional who can establish automated testing from the ground up, define risk\-based quality standards, and ensure releases meet clear readiness criteria before deployment. The Quality Engineering \& Release Manager will design and implement the automated test framework, establish testing and regression strategies, and own release readiness, change control, release documentation, and post\-release verification. The role will also serve as an escalation point for production issues and drive continuous improvement across quality and release practices. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, sound risk\-based judgment, and the ability to make and hold go/no\-go release decisions. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, the Scrum Master, and other stakeholders to ensure quality and release readiness are considered throughout the development lifecycle. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- This is a **hybrid position based in Lake Mary, Florida**. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and own the automated test framework from the ground up, including framework selection, initial test development, full end\-to\-end regression testing, CI integration, and adoption across Engineering. * Establish risk\-based test coverage standards and determine what should be automated, remain manual, or not require testing. * Own the Definition of Done, sprint exit criteria, regression strategy, test data strategy, and test environment strategy. * Shift quality earlier in the development lifecycle by reviewing acceptance criteria before work begins rather than relying solely on testing after development is complete. * Own release readiness criteria, facilitate go/no\-go discussions, and make release decisions in partnership with technical leadership. * Own change control end to end, including change records, approvals, audit trails, and record integrity. * Own release notes, rollback criteria, and post\-release verification. * Partner with Engineering on deployments. Engineering owns pipelines and infrastructure; this role owns whether established quality and release\-readiness criteria have been met for deployment to proceed. * Serve as an escalation tier for production issues, owning diagnosis, root\-cause analysis, and coordination through resolution. * Establish defect triage standards, severity definitions, and response expectations. * Ensure production defects result in appropriate regression tests and, when warranted, improvements to the release gate. * Partner with the Scrum Master and Product on planning, refinement, and flow, representing quality and release readiness throughout sprint activities. * Act as a liaison between Engineering teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating quality, test coverage, release readiness, risks, and delays. * Continuously evaluate and improve quality engineering and release\-management practices. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience building a test automation practice from the ground up and driving team adoption. * Experience owning release management in a sprint\-based environment, including change control in an audited or regulated context. * Demonstrated judgment and authority to make and hold go/no\-go release decisions. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining automated testing, including end\-to\-end regression testing. * Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration workflows. * Strong knowledge of test coverage, regression testing, test data, test environments, defect triage, root\-cause analysis, and release\-readiness practices. * Ability to assess risk, diagnose complex production and quality issues, make release\-readiness decisions with incomplete information, and determine practical corrective actions. * Ability to explain technical quality and coverage decisions to engineers and communicate release impacts clearly to executives and other stakeholders. * Ability to serve as an effective liaison between Engineering teams and stakeholders. * Professional/business proficiency in English with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical, stakeholder, and executive audiences. * Strong ability to work effectively in a computerized technology environment. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Jira and Confluence as systems of record. * Experience with performance, security, or accessibility testing. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ The Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Prototype Machinist
jobs.description: Therm\-x of California is the leading manufacture for Advanced Temperature and Control Systems for Hi\-Technology industries. We have been in business for over 30 years and have a diverse customer base. **We offer competitive pay, medical, dental, 401 (K), and paid time off.** The Prototype Machinist / NPI Technician works alongside Therm\-x's NPI Engineering team to bring new heater, sensor, source, and cathode designs from drawing to first working part. Our prototyping cell is built around a 5\-axis Okuma mill and a CNC lathe, and it runs separately from the production shop — giving this role the time and autonomy to make new parts the right way the first time. Because most prototypes are one\-off, complex geometries, this is fundamentally a 5\-axis and CAM\-programming role. The job is reading a fresh drawing, programming the toolpath, choosing the right way to hold and cut the part, talking with the design engineer about a tolerance that does not make sense, and shipping a clean first article. The same part is rarely run twice. When the cell is not loaded, this role also supports the NPI team with fixture builds, test setups, and general shop\-floor work. **Responsibilities include, but are not limited to;** * Program, set up, and operate the 5\-axis Okuma mill (and CNC lathe) to produce prototype parts, tools, and fixtures. * Generate efficient CAM programs (Mastercam, HSM, Esprit, NX CAM, or equivalent) from 3D models, including multi\-sided and simultaneous 5\-axis toolpaths. * Verify toolpaths in simulation before cutting; catch collisions, gouges, and reach issues at the CAM stage, not at the spindle. * Select cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and toolpath strategies appropriate for each prototype material and geometry. * Choose appropriate workholding — vises, soft jaws, clamps, custom fixtures, 5\-axis tombstones, and risers — for one\-off and low\-quantity parts. * Read and interpret engineering drawings with GD\&T; confirm critical dimensions and surface finishes. * Inspect parts using calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other standard inspection tools; record results for First Article Inspection (FAI). * Collaborate directly with mechanical engineers — flag drawing or manufacturability issues early, including DFM input on parts that should be redesigned for 5\-axis efficiency. * Build basic test fixtures and assist NPI engineers with prototype assembly, instrumentation, and data collection. * Maintain a clean, organized, and safe prototyping cell; track tooling, consumables, and machine condition. * Help evaluate new tools, processes, and machines as the prototyping cell evolves. * Support NPI technician work outside the cell as needed: test setups, basic data collection, and general shop\-floor support. **Desired Skills** * Hands\-on 5\-axis CNC milling experience — programming, set\-up, and operation. Okuma (OSP control) strongly preferred; equivalent 5\-axis platforms (DMG MORI, Mazak, Matsuura, Haas UMC) considered. * Strong CAM programming skills — Mastercam, HSM, Esprit, NX CAM, or equivalent — including multi\-sided and simultaneous 5\-axis toolpaths, with the ability to verify and post\-process programs reliably. * Solid grounding in milling principles: cutter selection, feeds and speeds, and how material, tooling, and fixture choices affect part quality on multi\-axis work. * Comfort reading drawings with GD\&T and interpreting tolerances correctly. * Confident use of standard inspection tools: calipers, micrometers, indicators, height gauges. * Computer literacy — opening files, viewing 3D models, running CAM simulations and machine simulations to catch collisions before cutting. * Strong written and verbal communication; able to talk through a drawing with an engineer, not just run parts. * Hands\-on, safety\-first work habits in an active shop environment. **Strong Plus*** Direct experience on Okuma machines and OSP control. * CNC lathe and mill\-turn experience. * Basic 3D modeling (SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion 360\) and the ability to design simple fixtures. * Probing and in\-process measurement on multi\-axis machines. * Prior NPI or prototype experience, or a job\-shop background with frequent setup changes. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **Work Environment:** high noise level associated with manufacturing facility
